description: Reply within an existing Canvas Inbox conversation. Every participant receives it. Use send_message to start a new thread. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true. Apps that can ask the user directly will show a confirmation instead.]

body.description: Message body text. Plain text or simple HTML.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

conversation_id.description: Inbox conversation ID (numeric string). Get it from list_conversations.

included_message_ids.description: Optional IDs of earlier messages in the thread to quote in this reply, from get_conversation.

name: reply_to_conversation
title: Reply To Conversation
